summary: Nuvation Bio Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose the full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option in its registered public offering of 0.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032. The additional $37.5 million aggregate principal amount was issued on July 6, 2026, bringing total offering size to $287.5 million. Net proceeds after underwriting discounts and expenses are estimated at $277.6 million, used partly to pay $2.2 million for capped call transactions and the balance for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
